title: Garden Graphers
shareTitle: Garden Graphers — Sort, Count, and Compare with Ari
description: Join Ari in a watercolor storybook garden: classify friendly visitors, grow their picture-graph columns, count each picture, and compare which groups have the most, fewest, or the same.
learningGoals: Classify bees, butterflies, and ladybugs by observable type
Use one-to-one correspondence to count picture-graph quantities to 6
Compare picture-graph columns as most, fewest, or the same
interactionModel: Choose one of three illustrated journal pages. Drag a garden visitor to its matching graph column or use tap-tap placement; tap each picture once to count a column; then tap one column or a matching pair to answer comparison prompts. Keyboard Enter and Space follow the same paths.
feedbackModel: Every correct action changes the field journal: visitors become aligned graph stamps, counted pictures receive a painted ring, and completed pages grow a distinct flower with Ari. Gentle wobble, spoken modeling, and visual hints support retries without scores, timers, or lost progress.
